text: R >= 4.3.0. Imports: data.table, Matrix, methods, parallel, splines, stats, utils. Everything else Suggests guarded need_pkg() requireNamespace(); tests use skip_if_not_installed(). Exported verbs carry mt_ prefix; model constructors nouns (lee_carter(), rwd(), tucker3(), apc_bayes()). test checks exports clash base, stats, utils, data.table, dplyr, forecast, generics, demography StMoMo. Errors warnings: mt_abort(msg, class = "<topic>") mt_warn(msg, class = "<topic>") give classes mt_error_<topic> mt_warning_<topic>; tests check classes, messages. Messages via mt_inform() (silent unless options(mortensor.verbose = TRUE)). data.table inside package: column names used non-standard evaluation go utils::globalVariables() R/mortensor-package.R. Never name local variable like column used [ call. Plot snapshots (vdiffr) made ggplot2 >= 4.0; regenerate intended change ggplot2 release (testthat::snapshot_review()). Precomputed vignette results: vignettes/comparison-results.rds comes dev/compare-packages.R (one hour); bamp vignette dev/precompute-vignettes.R. Randomness: functions simulate take seed = NULL use with_seed(); parallel code uses parallel L’Ecuyer streams. Code adapted packages carries header source, version, licence authors. print()/cat() messages outside print methods; plots return ggplot objects; files written outside tempdir().

title: Bayesian age-period-cohort models with bamp
text: use HMD data France (demography::fr.mort), 1970-2006, ages 40 . mimic official statistics, deaths grouped 5-year age groups open 100+ interval; exposures stay single years. bamp fitted deaths observed: 5-year age groups annual periods (periods_per_agegroup = 5, Knorr-Held Rainer 2001), cohorts defined single birth years. draws mapped single years age shape factors estimated ungrouped training data (step_ungroup()).
code: fr <- suppressWarnings(as_mt_data(demography::fr.mort, years = 1970:2006)) fr <- mt_regroup(fr, age = 40:100) x <- fr x$obs$deaths <- mt_regroup(fr, age = seq(40, 100, 5))$obs$deaths x #> <mt_data> 2 strata by sex, omega = 110 #>   deaths     5-year groups 40-99, 100+; periods 1970-2006 (width 1); 962 cells #>   exposure   single years 40-99, 100+; periods 1970-2006 (width 1); 4514 cells #>   grid       <mt_axis: age, 61 intervals> 40 41 42 43 ... 98 99 100+ #>              <mt_axis: period, 37 intervals> 1970 1971 1972 1973 ... 2004 2005 2006

title: Bayesian age-period-cohort models with bamp
text: mcmc_control("fast") runs four chains 5,000 iterations (burn-1,000, thinning 5). wrapper checks convergence bamp::checkConvergence() refits longer chains needed; stratum converge reported failed instead used. default priors second-order random walk age first-order random walks period cohort (see “Choice priors” ). Posterior medians 90% credible intervals effects (logit scale, identified bamp’s convention):
code: prep <- mt_prep(step_ungroup()) t0 <- proc.time() fit <- mt_fit(apc_bayes(mcmc = mcmc_control("fast")), x, prep = prep) (proc.time() - t0)[["elapsed"]] #> [1] 189.704 fit$diagnostics #>    stratum status                              message seconds #> 1:  female     ok                                       95.539 #> 2:    male     ok exposures rounded (max change 0.002)  90.889 eff <- mt_parameters(fit) eff[, .N, by = .(stratum, parameter)] #>    stratum parameter  N #> 1:  female       age 13 #> 2:  female    period 37 #> 3:  female    cohort 97 #> 4:    male       age 13 #> 5:    male    period 37 #> 6:    male    cohort 97 ggplot2::ggplot(eff, ggplot2::aes(as.numeric(index), value, colour = stratum, fill = stratum)) +   ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +   ggplot2::geom_line() +   ggplot2::facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") +   ggplot2::labs(x = "Index (age group, period or cohort)", y = "Effect (logit scale)", colour = NULL, fill = NULL)

title: Bayesian age-period-cohort models with bamp
text: Second-order random walks period cohort extrapolate recent trends, uncertainty grows quickly horizon. French women 90% forecast interval death rate ages 90-94 2021 (15 years ahead) compared choices: second-order random walks interval spans two orders magnitude, useful planning; first-order random walks narrow , backtest shows, biased mortality keeps declining. Neither choice right every dataset. Rolling-origin backtests way choose priors overdispersion term, ensemble models carry drift (ensemble()) way combine strengths.

Several rare, cells sex, quintile, 5-year age group year often hold handful deaths. ons_cause_groups keeps common cancers causes separate combines small causes within ICD-10 chapter. analysis starts age 50, groups enough deaths almost every cell (dementia diabetes sparse 50). deaths ons_data wide format, one column per cause. mt_data() reads listing cause columns levels stratum variable cause (-cause column named ""); populations cause shared causes. mt_subset() keeps ages 50 , mt_group_levels() combines causes. total = "" = "rest", rest causes minus groups, also holds deaths causes table list (including suicide). Estimation: Poisson maximum likelihood (default; Brouhns, Denuit Vermunt 2002) SVD log rates (method = "svd", demography::lca()), k(t) re-estimated match observed total deaths (adjust = "dt"), deaths age ("dxt", Booth, Maindonald Smith 2002) life expectancy ("e0", Lee Miller 2001). choose_period = TRUE fits model longest recent period k(t) close linear (Booth, Maindonald Smith 2002). Forecast: k(t) follows random walk drift; drift innovation variance estimated year--year changes k(t). Jump-: fitted rates last year (default) observed rates (jump_off = "observed"). title: Your own data, from CSV to report
text: code writes two CSV files (semicolon-separated, many European exports). data, start files.
code: set.seed(42) ages <- c("unter 1 Jahr", "1 bis unter 5 Jahre", paste(seq(5, 85, 5), "bis unter", seq(10, 90, 5), "Jahre"),           "90 Jahre und mehr") lo <- c(0, 1, seq(5, 90, 5)) g <- CJ(Jahr = 2005:2022, Geschlecht = 1:2, Quintil = 1:5, k = seq_along(ages)) g[, Altersgruppe := ages[k]] g[, bev := round(4e4 * exp(-lo[k] / 45) * (1 + 0.1 * (Quintil == 1)))] g[, rate := exp(-10.1 + 0.09 * (lo[k] + 2) + 0.3 * (Geschlecht == 1) + 0.12 * (5 - Quintil) - 0.015 * (Jahr - 2005))] g[k == 1, rate := 0.004] g[Jahr %in% 2020:2022, rate := rate * 1.12]                 # pandemic years g[, Gestorbene := rpois(.N, bev * pmin(rate, 0.7))] deaths <- g[, .(Jahr, Geschlecht, Quintil, Altersgruppe,                 Gestorbene = ifelse(Gestorbene == 0, "-", ifelse(Gestorbene < 3, ".", Gestorbene)))] totals <- g[, .(Altersgruppe = "Insgesamt", Gestorbene = as.character(sum(Gestorbene))),             by = .(Jahr, Geschlecht, Quintil)] deaths <- rbind(deaths, totals) pop <- g[, .(Stichtag = Jahr, Geschlecht, Quintil, Altersgruppe, Bevoelkerung = bev)] pop <- rbind(pop[Stichtag == 2005][, Stichtag := 2004], pop)   # 31 December of the year before f_deaths <- file.path(tempdir(), "gestorbene.csv") f_pop <- file.path(tempdir(), "bevoelkerung.csv") fwrite(deaths, f_deaths, sep = ";") fwrite(pop, f_pop, sep = ";")

Hierarchies: mt_hierarchy() describes crossed nested strata (example sex x region x deprivation quintile totals), mt_aggregate_strata() adds aggregates, mt_reconcile() reconciled() make forecasts add draw draw, mt_order_strata() imposes orderings. Wrappers model: ensemble(), reconciled(), calibrated() (spread fitted recent forecast errors), anchored() (jump-observed level), bootstrapped() tuned(). Evaluation: mt_backtest() mt_score(), rates, life expectancy age-standardised rates. past: mt_observed(), mt_contrast() mt_inequality(). title: Estimate suppressed death counts — mt_fill_suppressed
text: published totals (hierarchy): missing cells every aggregate known total must add total minus known cells. estimated iterative proportional fitting (raking): starting values, expected deaths pooled death rate age period, scaled constraint constraint every total matched. two crossed variables (regions causes) result log-linear independence fit missing cells given margins. Missing aggregates filled sums parts. bounds suppressed counts (lower, upper): range suppression rule implies, example lower = 1, upper = 2 counts 1 2 suppressed, upper = 4 "<5". Estimates kept inside bounds raking. Cells published total covers get expected deaths pooled rate, limited bounds; needs finite upper. Without bounds, cells published total covers stay missing (warning). estimates plausible values agree published information; carry information beyond , forecasts strata many estimated cells less certain intervals suggest. Filled cells marked provenance "estimated". known cells aggregate already exceed total (inconsistent data), missing cells aggregate set lower bound case reported.

title: mortensor 0.1.9000 (development of 0.2.0)
text: Renamed clarity: model wrappers nouns like model constructors, ensemble(), reconciled(), tuned(), bootstrapped() (mt_ensemble(), mt_reconciled(), mt_tuned(), mt_bootstrap()); mt_order_strata() (mt_cohere()); mt_parameters() replaces lc_parameters() apc_effects(); mt_window() internal (mt_subset(periods = )). Hierarchies: additivity per variable (mt_hierarchy(region = "DE", cause = list(total = "", additive = "rates"))); exposures crossed region--cause hierarchies summed regions taken causes aggregation, validation reconciliation. , -cause exposures multiplied number causes. mt_fill_suppressed() takes bounds suppressed counts (lower, upper), also without published totals; stops total hierarchy data leaves uncovered cells missing (, kept exposures starting values). Inspection: summary() fits (model, sources uncertainty, fit), mt_parameters() Lee-Carter, Li-Lee, product-ratio, random walks Bayesian APC models (R-hat), fitted(), residuals(), mt_plot_residuals(). Results: mt_observed() observed indicators (life_expectancy(), asr(), prob_dying() accept data, Poisson intervals), mt_contrast() (differences ratios strata, path path), mt_inequality() (slope relative index inequality), life_expectancy(paths = TRUE), asr(per = ) ages, standard per columns, standards "esp1976" "who2000", mt_export() table. Future exposures (mt_deaths(), mt_forecast(), mt_reconcile(), mt_aggregate_draws()) matched age, year stratum names can mt_data objects; unnamed arrays give warning. Data input: broader age labels ("1 4", "85 years ", "90 & ", German labels), financial years ("2001/02"), total rows left unknown ages distributed warnings, thousands separators decimal = ",", trimmed labels, warnings levels differ tables, detection total levels among parts, mt_relabel(), mt_regroup(age = "common"); mt_as_exposure() needs explicit type; mt_read_genesis() makes analysis decisions. Errors name missing periods, strata cells likely cause; duplicates name unused columns; overlapping age groups rates 1 located. Robustness: Lee-Carter handles age groups without deaths sparse counts (ridge fallback); failed strata give one warning; forecasts rates 1 give warning; rwd(observation_noise = TRUE) pools level variance ages deaths ; smoothing leaves age 0 respects group widths; models one age group work. Backtests: n_origins origins complete horizons, seeded PIT, estimated cells scored default (score_estimated). step_window() (fitting period), as_demogdata(), as_stmomodata(), plots original data (data), stratum selection facets life expectancy, share plots take defaults hierarchy, warning h given. Documentation: reference index analysis step, function map workflow diagrams, “Model reference” vignette, model-choice table aggregation table FAQ, references 0.1 internal files help pages. Data layer: mt_axis (single_ages(), age_groups(), single_years(), parse_age_labels()), mt_data() tables resolution, mt_grid()/mt_set_grid(), mt_array(), mt_granularity(), mt_validate() (including hierarchy sums), mt_regroup(), mt_operator(), mt_as_exposure(), as_mt_data() data frames, StMoMoData demogdata, simulated mt_example(). Native penalized composite link model mt_ungroup(): deaths ungrouped rates exposures offset; open interval expanded omega; 1D (default) 2D; group totals preserved. mt_smooth() preprocessing pipelines (mt_prep(), step_*()) backtests refit every training window. Interval-aware life_table() life_expectancy() (also path path forecast draws). Model contract (mt_fit(), mt_forecast(), mt_draws) models rwd(), lee_carter() (Poisson SVD; agrees StMoMo demography), tucker3() (native HOOI; log CoDa), arima_series(), ets_series(), ensemble(). apc_bayes(): seamless wrapper bamp package (Bayesian age-period-cohort models) convergence checks draws grid. Plots (mt_plot_*(), ggplot2), HMD readers (mt_from_hmd(), mt_read_hmd()), four vignettes using HMD data. Ports 0.1 models methods: hyndman_ullah(), stmomo() (APC, CBD, RH, M6, LC), li_lee(), product_ratio(), cause_shares() (Tucker4-ILR multi-cause forecasts), mt_reconcile() (MinT, WLS, OLS), mt_order_strata(), stacking weights ensemble(), Whittaker GAM smoothing, Kannisto closure life_table(), monotone splitting deaths, simulated multi-cause dataset mt_example_causes(). Grouped hierarchies coherent forecasts (example sex x region x deprivation quintile): mt_hierarchy(), mt_aggregate_strata(), multi-variable hierarchy checks mt_validate(), mt_reconcile() death scale WLS, MinT, structural, OLS bottom-reconciliation, empirical copula separately fitted strata non-negativity; reconciled() reconciliation inside fits backtests; mt_aggregate_draws(); li_lee(common_by = "sex"); simulated mt_example_regions() vignette. Rate-based spline ungrouping (mt_ungroup(method = "hyman_kannisto"), "natural_gompertz", "gam"), mt_disaggregate() forecast draws, bootstrapped() (parameter preprocessing uncertainty Poisson resampling refitting) information-criterion rank selection tucker3(ranks = "bic"). “Frequently asked questions” vignette; vdiffr snapshot tests plots; Tucker factor signs fixed fits identical across LAPACK builds. Vignettes “Getting started” “Causes death deprivation” use ons_data; 0.1--0.2 migration vignette removed. li_lee() product_ratio() gain jump_off = "observed"; Lee-Carter labels name variant (SVD, observed jump-, bootstrap). asr() prob_dying() return values every path paths = TRUE; mt_plot_shares() gains groups causes filters. General preprocessing replaces dataset-specific readers (mt_read_ons() removed): mt_data() reads text values symbols suppressed missing cells (missing, zero), wide tables one value column per level stratum variable (one column per sex cause), tables without stratum columns, shared levels (populations shared causes death). mt_group_levels() adds aggregation layer stratum variable (cause groups, deciles quintiles, districts regions) summed shared exposures, residual group (, total minus groups) new name layer. mt_subset() restricts strata, ages periods. mt_regroup(age = "deaths") aggregates age groups table. default modelling grid coarsest grid every table exact (age groups data tables share ), models fit grouped data directly; mt_ungroup() ungroups single years default (new argument age). error deaths coarser grid names remedies. Fixed: reconciled predictive draws rate-additive hierarchies (causes) returned aggregated deaths instead rates; European Standard Population weights 95+ dropped open 90+ grid group; smoothing 5-year age groups failed singular starting values. rwd(observation_noise = TRUE): random walk drift plus noise (local level model); sharper plain random walk. Interval calibration random walks, Lee-Carter ensembles simulated, HMD ONS data documented dev/calibration.md; defaults stay. ons_data: deaths cause populations sex, age group IMD decile, England 2001-2019 (ONS ad hoc release 3064, Open Government Licence), cause groups ons_cause_groups; built data-raw/ons_data.R. German regional data: de_deaths (deaths Land, sex, age group ICD-10 chapter, 1998-2024, GBE-Bund) de_population (31 December populations, GENESIS-Online), Datenlizenz Deutschland -2-0; mt_read_gbe() parses GBE-Bund exports, mt_fill_suppressed() estimates suppressed death counts raking published totals. mt_as_exposure(type = "dec31") populations 31 December. Missing cells reported mt_validate(). Ensembles draw one component per path strata (, components picked separately per stratum, broke dependence strata coherence reconciled components); every model type tested component. mt_read_genesis() reads deaths 31 December populations flat CSV format GENESIS-Online (Destatis); parse_age_labels() understands German age labels. apc_select() (DIC-based choice random-walk orders apc_bayes()), plots mt_plot_tucker(), mt_plot_shares() mt_plot_scores(). mt_tune() tuned(); prob_dying(), asr() (ESP 2013), yll(), mt_export(). mt_backtest() (rolling origin, scored observed resolution) mt_score() (CRPS, WIS, coverage, PIT, MASE). Validation pipeline validation/ GitHub workflows R CMD check (R 4.3 devel), coverage, lint validation. Dependencies reduced data.table Matrix (plus base packages).

title: mortensor 0.1.1
text: Maintenance release 0.2 rewrite (see dev/implementation-plan.md). %||% imported rlang, package works R < 4.4 (review D1). forecast() accuracy() generics generics package (re-exported); methods dispatch correctly library(forecast) (D2). Licence changed GPL-3. Undefined global variables declared; stray files removed repository. dev/baseline/ records point forecasts every model regression baseline rewrite.
